funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants

amount.raw: Small, up to £2,000; Large, from £2,001 to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals at any stage of their career; applicant must be the author or editor of the proposed publication. Must have a publisher confirmed and a publication date scheduled within three years of applying. Open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals seeking to disseminate research on British art through the publication of monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles, covering costs such as images, subventions, external contributors' fees and translation costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed. Organisations can only apply for one Research Project Grant per round.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research projects in the field of British art, designed primarily to support staff costs towards the facilitation of a research project with public-facing outcomes and/or legacy.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; the exhibition from which the publication is based on can either be forthcoming or have already taken place.
opportunities.summary: Support the dissemination of research on British art by helping organisations produce publications related to their exhibitions and displays, covering practical publishing costs such as image and production costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Support the dissemination of research on British art through live, online and hybrid events put on by an organisation and intended for a variety of audiences, covering costs such as venue hire, accommodation for speakers and staffing.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking a conservation research project or technical analysis which will lead to a research project. Items supported must be in public or charitable ownership and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Help protect and preserve significant works of British art by providing organisations with funding to undertake original and needed conservation research, supporting staff costs and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking work to digitise items and material in their own collections (photographic collections, archival collections, bound volumes, objects, paintings, publications or other assets relating to British art).
opportunities.summary: Financial support to organisations seeking to make their collections freely available to audiences online via digitisation, covering costs of personnel working on the project as well as equipment needed in the digitisation process.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA) Research Travel Bursaries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be a Member of ERBA (Emerging Researchers in British Art); those with pending membership may apply.
opportunities.summary: Small micro-grants for ERBA Members to support research-related travel, such as visits to libraries, archives, collections or sites, or travel to meet a key contact or attend a research-related event, covering transport, accommodation and reasonable expenses.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at any stage of their career for tiers up to £8,000; the £8,001-£20,000 tier requires postdoctoral level or equivalent research experience or above. Open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for individuals undertaking research in the field of British art, supporting research time (including backfill for those in employment) and/or research travel to view collections or visit archives, plus some additional costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals enrolled to start (with a place confirmed), or already undertaking, a master's level or doctoral level degree in the field of British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals beginning or continuing a master's level or doctoral level degree who may face barriers in being able to undertake their course of study.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to registered students at undergraduate level and above, from any country. Project must focus on British works of art on paper from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries (prints, drawings, watercolours).
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support from the Andrew Wyld Fund so students can undertake research trips to examine historical works on paper (prints, drawings, watercolours) firsthand.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: total of £32,000 for one year, or split over two years if taken part time

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a master's degree place at a UK-based institution, due to begin the course between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master's level degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) in the field of British art, designed to bring new perspectives to our understanding of British art and increase diversity of perspectives.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: total of £96,000 awarded as £32,000 a year for three years (or split over further years if required)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals who have applied for, or are in receipt of, an offer of a doctorate degree place at a UK-based institution, due to begin between April 2027 and April 2028. International applicants not qualifying for home fees may apply but must source extra funding themselves.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support doctoral research that will expand our understanding of British art through new perspectives, paying for university fees with the remaining amount supporting living expenses, plus an extra £500 per year for networking.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: one year at £35,000, or two years at £70,000 (paid £35,000 per year)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at postdoctoral level (or with equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals looking to undertake a major in-depth research project in the field of British art that will reshape our understanding of British art, part of the New Narratives scheme to increase diversity of perspectives.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship

amount.raw: Full board and accommodation at the British School at Rome for three months, as well as an honorarium

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre-doctoral PhD candidates to those internationally recognised in their field.
opportunities.summary: A three-month stay at the British School at Rome for individuals undertaking advanced research on a British-Italian topic relating to cultural contact, exchange and influence between Britain and Italy.
